name: Indus Hospital
mission:
Friends of Indus Hospital, Inc (FOIH) is a US-based 501(c)(3) registered charity. We strive to create awareness about the healthcare needs of underprivileged patients and raise funds to provide them with equitable care. By supporting healthcare efforts in Pakistan, FOIH is helping to ensure that vulnerable individuals have access to the healthcare they need, regardless of financial or other barriers.
Through annual fundraising initiatives, community events, and awareness drives, we seek to mobilize a strong tradition of community giving and a shared commitment to changing the paradigm of healthcare delivery in Pakistan.
FOIH is an initiative taken by Americans of Pakistani origin expatriates and supported by a wider community across the USA.
All donations given to FOIH are eligible for tax deduction under US law.

rich_narrative.summary: Friends of Indus Hospital supports the efforts of the Indus Hospital & Health Network to provide direct medical care in Pakistan <cite id="3">in FY2024 with total revenue of $14,742,480</cite>. The organization delivers specialized healthcare services, including prosthetic limb distribution and neonatal care, free of charge to underserved populations <cite id="2">across Pakistan</cite>. Its financial and operational metrics show a balanced profile. The organization holds <cite id="2">an 87/100 overall rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and earned a <cite id="2">86.8% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, alongside <cite id="2">fundraising costs of $0.18 per $1 raised</cite>. At the same time, the charity faces clear operational constraints. Financial reserves remain low at <cite id="2">1.8 months of working capital</cite>, and overall revenue has stayed roughly flat with a 3-year CAGR of -2.6%. Additionally, the organization lacks a documented theory of change and maintains limited board governance documentation.
